title: Lockheed Martin to Invest Over $8 Billion Through 2030 to Expand Missile Production: PAC-3, THAAD, JATM and PrSM
excerpt: Lockheed Martin CEO Jim Taiclet said the company will invest more than $8 billion through 2030 to expand missile production and modernize more than 20 facilities.
rank_math_title: Lockheed Martin to invest $8 billion in missile production | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: Lockheed Martin will invest over $8 billion through 2030 to expand missile output. PAC-3 and THAAD contracts, JATM and PrSM Increment 2 anchor the expansion.
